plans.label: vault/select_secret_envelope
plans.sql:
SELECT dek_ciphertext, dek_nonce, dek_tag, secret_nonce, secret_ciphertext, secret_tag, kek_version
  FROM vault.secrets
 WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND key_name = $2

plans.label: vault/select_secret_projections
plans.sql:
SELECT key_name, created_at, meta_kind, meta_provider, meta_base_url
  FROM vault.secrets
 WHERE workspace_id = $1
 ORDER BY key_name ASC

plans.label: vault/select_named_envelopes
plans.sql:
SELECT key_name, dek_ciphertext, dek_nonce, dek_tag,
       secret_nonce, secret_ciphertext, secret_tag, kek_version
  FROM vault.secrets
 WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND key_name = ANY($2::text[])
 ORDER BY key_name ASC

plans.label: vault/select_shared_generations
plans.sql:
SELECT key_name,
       dek_ciphertext, dek_nonce, dek_tag, secret_nonce, secret_ciphertext, secret_tag, kek_version,
       encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(
           id, kek_version, encode(sha256(secret_ciphertext), 'hex')
       )::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex') AS resolution_version
  FROM vault.secrets
 WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND key_name = ANY($2::text[])
 ORDER BY key_name
   FOR SHARE

plans.label: vault/select_scoped_secret_descriptors
plans.sql:
SELECT s.workspace_id, s.key_name, s.meta_kind, s.meta_provider,
       s.meta_base_url, s.meta_has_key
  FROM unnest($1::uuid[], $2::text[]) AS r(workspace_id, key_name)
  JOIN vault.secrets s ON s.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND s.key_name = r.key_name
